## Description {#details}

<p>The possible results of an alias query.</p>


<p>These results are always computed between two <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/memorylocation">MemoryLocation</a> objects as a query to some alias analysis.</p>


<p>Note that these are unscoped enumerations because we would like to support implicitly testing a result for the existence of any possible aliasing with a conversion to bool, but an "enum class" doesn't support this. The canonical names from the literature are suffixed and unique anyways, and so they serve as global constants in LLVM for these results.</p>


<p>See docs/AliasAnalysis.html for more information on the specific meanings of these values.</p>


<p>Definition at line 77 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/aliasanalysis-h">AliasAnalysis.h</a>.</p>
